display_name: Meesho query pattern — Net revenue / net GMV after returns
name: Meesho query pattern — Net revenue / net GMV after returns

name: Meesho query pattern — 7.3 Return Rate

name: Meesho query pattern — 7.4 Average Order Value (AOV)

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.5 Effective Payout Ratio
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.5 Effective Payout Ratio

SELECT

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.6 Effective Shipping Cost Rate
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.6 Effective Shipping Cost Rate
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(taxable_shipping + shipping_gst_18_percent)
    / NULLIF(
        (SELECT SUM(charged_amount) FROM zs_observe.meesho_sales WHERE is_active = true),
        0), 2) AS shipping_as_pct_of_gmv
FROM zs_observe.meesho_forward_expenses
WHERE CAST(is_active AS VARCHAR) = 'true';

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.7 Total Cost of Returns
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.7 Total Cost of Returns
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  SUM(return_logistic_charge_excluding_tax) AS return_logistics_excl_gst,
  SUM(return_logistic_charge_gst) AS return_logistics_gst,
  SUM(ABS(settled_amount)) AS total_negative_settlement
FROM zs_observe.meesho_settlement
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status IN ('Return', 'RTO');

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.8 Brand-Level GMV
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.8 Brand-Level GMV
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT b.brand,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS orders,
  SUM(s.charged_amount) AS gmv
FROM zs_observe.meesho_sales s
JOIN zs_observe.meesho_brand_mapping b ON s.order_id = b.order_id AND b.is_active = true
WHERE s.is_active = true
GROUP BY b.brand ORDER BY gmv DESC;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 8.1 Sales ↔ Settlement Match
name: Meesho query pattern — 8.1 Sales ↔ Settlement Match
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  s.sub_order_num, s.charged_amount AS oms_gmv,
  st.settled_amount AS net_payout,
  CASE WHEN st.order_id IS NULL THEN 'Unmatched' ELSE 'Matched' END AS status
FROM zs_observe.meesho_sales s
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_settlement st
  ON s.sub_order_num = st.order_id AND st.is_active = true
WHERE s.is_active = true;
-- Coverage: 1,489/1,792 = 83% match

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 8.2 Forward Expenses ↔ Settlement Validation
name: Meesho query pattern — 8.2 Forward Expenses ↔ Settlement Validation
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  f.sub_order_num,
  f.taxable_shipping AS expense_shipping,
  f.meesho_mall_platformfee AS expense_mall_fee,
  ABS(s.freight_charge) AS settlement_freight,
  ABS(s.mp_fees) AS settlement_mp_fees,
  ROUND(f.taxable_shipping - ABS(s.freight_charge), 2) AS shipping_variance
FROM zs_observe.meesho_forward_expenses f
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_settlement s
  ON f.sub_order_num = s.order_id AND s.is_active = true
WHERE CAST(f.is_active AS VARCHAR) = 'true';

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 8.3 Return ↔ Reverse Logistics Reconciliation
name: Meesho query pattern — 8.3 Return ↔ Reverse Logistics Reconciliation
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  'Other Charges table' AS source, SUM(taxable_value) AS total
FROM zs_observe.meesho_other_charges_expenses
WHERE is_active = true AND LOWER(type) = 'reverse_shipping'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Settlement table', SUM(ABS(return_logistic_charge_excluding_tax))
FROM zs_observe.meesho_settlement
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status IN ('Return', 'RTO');
-- Expected: ₹39,614 vs ₹54,389 — gap = returns not yet in other_charges

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 8.4 Brand-Level Return Rate
name: Meesho query pattern — 8.4 Brand-Level Return Rate
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  b.brand,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rv.order_id) AS returns,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT rv.order_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.meesho_brand_mapping b
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_sales s ON b.order_id = s.order_id AND s.is_active = true
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_reverse rv ON b.order_id = rv.order_id AND rv.is_active = true
WHERE b.is_active = true
GROUP BY b.brand;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 8.5 TCS Reconciliation
name: Meesho query pattern — 8.5 TCS Reconciliation
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', settlement_date) AS month,
  SUM(tcs_taxable_amount) AS tcs_base_from_sales,
  (SELECT SUM(ABS(total_tcs_amount)) FROM zs_observe.meesho_settlement
   WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'Delivered') AS tcs_deducted_in_settlement
FROM zs_observe.meesho_sales WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 5. Query Template
name: Meesho query pattern — 5. Query Template
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', cancel_return_date) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS returns,
  SUM(taxable_shipping) AS reverse_shipping_excl_gst,
  SUM(shipping_gst_18_percent) AS reverse_shipping_gst,
  SUM(meesho_mall_platformfee) AS mall_fee,
  SUM(taxable_shipping + shipping_gst_18_percent + meesho_mall_platformfee) AS total_return_cost
FROM zs_observe.meesho_reverse_expenses

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.1 Monthly Reverse Shipping Cost
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.1 Monthly Reverse Shipping Cost
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS returns,
  SUM(taxable_value) AS reverse_shipping_excl_gst,
  ROUND(SUM(taxable_value) * 1.18, 2) AS reverse_shipping_incl_gst
FROM zs_observe.meesho_other_charges_expenses
WHERE is_active = true
  AND LOWER(type) = 'reverse_shipping'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.2 Join to Reverse Orders for Full Cost View
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.2 Join to Reverse Orders for Full Cost View
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  o.sub_order_num,
  o.taxable_value AS reverse_shipping_excl_gst,
  ROUND(o.taxable_value * 1.18, 2) AS reverse_shipping_incl_gst,
  r.charged_amount AS original_order_value,
  r.order_status AS return_type
FROM zs_observe.meesho_other_charges_expenses o
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_reverse r
  ON o.sub_order_num = r.sub_order_num
  AND r.is_active = true
WHERE o.is_active = true
  AND o.type = 'Reverse_shipping';

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.3 Reconcile with Settlement Return Logistics
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.3 Reconcile with Settlement Return Logistics
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  'Other Charges (invoice-level)' AS source,
  SUM(taxable_value) AS total_reverse_logistics
FROM zs_observe.meesho_other_charges_expenses
WHERE is_active = true AND LOWER(type) = 'reverse_shipping'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Settlement (order-level)',
  SUM(return_logistic_charge_excluding_tax)
FROM zs_observe.meesho_settlement
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status IN ('Return', 'RTO');

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.1 Return Volume by Type and Courier
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.1 Return Volume by Type and Courier
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  return_type,
  return_sub_type,
  courier_partner,
  COUNT(*) AS returns,
  SUM(qty) AS units_returned
FROM zs_observe.meesho_returns
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY returns DESC;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.2 Return Cycle Time (Days to Return)
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.2 Return Cycle Time (Days to Return)
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  courier_partner,
  AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', return_created_date, delivered_date)) AS avg_days_to_return,
  MIN(DATE_DIFF('day', return_created_date, delivered_date)) AS min_days,
  MAX(DATE_DIFF('day', return_created_date, delivered_date)) AS max_days
FROM zs_observe.meesho_returns
WHERE is_active = true
  AND delivered_date IS NOT NULL
  AND return_created_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY courier_partner;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.3 Category-Level Return Analysis
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.3 Category-Level Return Analysis
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  REPLACE(category, '_Mall', '') AS normalized_category,
  COUNT(*) AS return_count,
  COUNT_IF(return_sub_type = 'FIRST_RET') AS first_returns,
  COUNT_IF(return_type = 'Courier Return RTO') AS rto_count,
  COUNT_IF(return_price_type = 'Wrong/Defective Return Price') AS defective_returns
FROM zs_observe.meesho_returns
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY return_count DESC;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.4 Join Returns → Reverse for Financial Context
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.4 Join Returns → Reverse for Financial Context
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  r.order_id,
  r.product_name, r.sku, r.category,
  r.return_type, r.return_sub_type, r.courier_partner,
  rv.charged_amount AS order_value,
  rv.total_tax AS gst_amount
FROM zs_observe.meesho_returns r
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_reverse rv
  ON r.order_id = rv.order_id
  AND rv.is_active = true
WHERE r.is_active = true;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.1 Brand GMV from Sales
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.1 Brand GMV from Sales
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  COALESCE(b.brand, 'Unknown') AS brand,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.sub_order_num) AS orders,
  SUM(s.charged_amount) AS gmv,
  AVG(s.charged_amount) AS aov
FROM zs_observe.meesho_sales s
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_brand_mapping b
  ON s.order_id = b.order_id
  AND b.is_active = true
WHERE s.is_active = true
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY gmv DESC;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.2 SKU-Level Return Rate
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.2 SKU-Level Return Rate
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  b.sku_id,
  b.brand,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS returns,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM zs_observe.meesho_brand_mapping b
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_sales s ON b.order_id = s.order_id AND s.is_active = true
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_reverse r ON b.order_id = r.order_id AND r.is_active = true
WHERE b.is_active = true AND b.sku_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY b.sku_id, b.brand
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) > 5
ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.3 MRP vs Charged Amount Discount Analysis
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.3 MRP vs Charged Amount Discount Analysis
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  b.brand,
  AVG(b.mrp) AS avg_mrp,
  AVG(s.charged_amount) AS avg_charged,
  ROUND(100.0 * (AVG(b.mrp) - AVG(s.charged_amount)) / NULLIF(AVG(b.mrp), 0), 2) AS avg_discount_pct
FROM zs_observe.meesho_brand_mapping b
JOIN zs_observe.meesho_sales s ON b.order_id = s.order_id AND s.is_active = true
WHERE b.is_active = true AND b.mrp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY b.brand;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.4 State-Level Brand Distribution
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.4 State-Level Brand Distribution
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  b.brand,
  b.destination_state,
  COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM zs_observe.meesho_brand_mapping b
WHERE b.is_active = true AND b.brand IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, orders DESC;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.1 Return + RTO Financial Summary
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.1 Return + RTO Financial Summary
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  COALESCE(order_status, 'Unknown') AS status,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  SUM(charged_amount) AS reversed_gmv,
  SUM(charged_amount_excluding_tax) AS taxable_base,
  SUM(total_tax) AS gst_reversed,
  SUM(tcs_taxable_amount) AS tcs_base_reversed,
  AVG(charged_amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM zs_observe.meesho_reverse
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.2 Forward vs Reverse Net GMV
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.2 Forward vs Reverse Net GMV
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT 'Forward Sales' AS flow,
  SUM(charged_amount) AS gmv,
  COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM zs_observe.meesho_sales
WHERE is_active = true
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Reverse (Returns/RTO/Cancel)',
  SUM(charged_amount), COUNT(*)
FROM zs_observe.meesho_reverse
WHERE is_active = true;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.3 Intra-State vs Inter-State Returns
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.3 Intra-State vs Inter-State Returns
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN UPPER(source_state) = UPPER(destination_state) THEN 'Intra-State'
    ELSE 'Inter-State'
  END AS gst_type,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt,
  SUM(tax_igst_amount) AS igst,
  SUM(tax_cgst_amount) AS cgst,
  SUM(tax_sgst_amount) AS sgst
FROM zs_observe.meesho_reverse
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.4 Return Rate Calculation
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.4 Return Rate Calculation
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.5 Join Reverse → Settlement Reconciliation
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.5 Join Reverse → Settlement Reconciliation
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  r.sub_order_num,

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.6 HSN-Level Return Analysis
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.6 HSN-Level Return Analysis
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  hsn,
  COUNT(*) AS returns,
  SUM(charged_amount) AS reversed_gmv,
  AVG(charged_amount) AS avg_return_value

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.1 Monthly Expense Breakdown
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.1 Monthly Expense Breakdown
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders,
  SUM(taxable_shipping) AS shipping_excl_gst,
  SUM(shipping_gst_18_percent) AS shipping_gst,
  SUM(taxable_shipping + shipping_gst_18_percent) AS total_shipping_incl_gst,
  SUM(meesho_mall_platformfee) AS mall_platform_fee,
  SUM(meesho_mall_platformfee_gst) AS mall_fee_gst,
  SUM(fixed_fee) AS fixed_fees,
  SUM(net_commission) AS commission,
  SUM(taxable_shipping + shipping_gst_18_percent
      + meesho_mall_platformfee + meesho_mall_platformfee_gst
      + fixed_fee) AS total_expense_incl_gst
FROM zs_observe.meesho_forward_expenses
WHERE CAST(is_active AS VARCHAR) = 'true'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.2 Validate Against Settlement Deductions
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.2 Validate Against Settlement Deductions
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  f.sub_order_num,
  f.taxable_shipping AS expense_shipping,
  f.meesho_mall_platformfee AS expense_platform_fee,
  ABS(s.freight_charge) AS settlement_freight,
  ABS(s.mp_fees) AS settlement_mp_fees,
  f.taxable_shipping - ABS(s.freight_charge) AS shipping_variance,
  f.meesho_mall_platformfee - ABS(s.mp_fees) AS platform_fee_variance
FROM zs_observe.meesho_forward_expenses f
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_settlement s
  ON f.sub_order_num = s.order_id
  AND s.is_active = true
WHERE CAST(f.is_active AS VARCHAR) = 'true';

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.3 Mall vs Non-Mall Orders
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.3 Mall vs Non-Mall Orders
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN meesho_mall_platformfee > 0 THEN 'Mall SKU' ELSE 'Standard SKU' END AS sku_tier,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  AVG(taxable_shipping) AS avg_shipping,
  AVG(meesho_mall_platformfee) AS avg_mall_fee,
  SUM(taxable_shipping + meesho_mall_platformfee) AS total_charges_excl_gst
FROM zs_observe.meesho_forward_expenses
WHERE CAST(is_active AS VARCHAR) = 'true'
GROUP BY 1;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 7.4 Effective Cost Per Delivered Order
name: Meesho query pattern — 7.4 Effective Cost Per Delivered Order
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  supplier_id,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  SUM(taxable_shipping + shipping_gst_18_percent
      + meesho_mall_platformfee + meesho_mall_platformfee_gst
      + fixed_fee) AS total_platform_cost,
  AVG(taxable_shipping + shipping_gst_18_percent
      + meesho_mall_platformfee + meesho_mall_platformfee_gst) AS avg_cost_per_order
FROM zs_observe.meesho_forward_expenses
WHERE CAST(is_active AS VARCHAR) = 'true'
GROUP BY supplier_id;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 8.1 Full Waterfall Summary
name: Meesho query pattern — 8.1 Full Waterfall Summary
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  SUM(sale_settled_amount) AS gross_sale,
  SUM(mp_fees) AS platform_fee,
  SUM(freight_charge) AS shipping,
  SUM(return_logistic_charge_excluding_tax) AS return_logistics,
  SUM(total_tcs_amount) AS tcs,
  SUM(total_tds) AS tds,
  SUM(compensation_recovery) AS compensation,
  SUM(settled_amount) AS net_payout
FROM zs_observe.meesho_settlement
WHERE is_active = true AND order_status = 'Delivered';

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 8.2 Settlement by Month
name: Meesho query pattern — 8.2 Settlement by Month
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', settlement_date) AS month,
  order_status,
  COUNT(*) AS records,
  SUM(settled_amount) AS net_settled
FROM zs_observe.meesho_settlement
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 8.3 OMS ↔ Settlement Match
name: Meesho query pattern — 8.3 OMS ↔ Settlement Match
required_filters: Preserve filters exactly as shown in source SQL; active/scope-like filters are columns/caveats only, not account-binding cards.
sql_template:
SELECT
  s.sub_order_num, s.charged_amount AS oms_gmv,
  st.sale_settled_amount, st.settled_amount,
  CASE WHEN st.order_id IS NULL THEN 'Unmatched' ELSE 'Matched' END AS status
FROM zs_observe.meesho_sales s
LEFT JOIN zs_observe.meesho_settlement st
  ON s.sub_order_num = st.order_id AND st.is_active = true

display_name: Meesho query pattern — 8.4 TCS + TDS Summary
name: Meesho query pattern — 8.4 TCS + TDS Summary

  DATE_TRUNC('month', settlement_date) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  SUM(total_tcs_amount) AS tcs_deducted,
